The quick-menu select control has no associated label or accessible name.
Changing the select value immediately navigates the page, but the control provides no instruction that selection triggers navigation and may cause unexpected context changes.
The news links' onfocus handlers call blur(), removing keyboard focus and preventing a visible focus indicator.
The black headline text on the light gray background has insufficient contrast (approximately 3.5:1), below the 4.5:1 requirement for normal text.
The page's visible section titles are paragraphs styled as headings rather than semantic heading elements, so the content structure is not conveyed to assistive technology.
The logo is wrapped in an anchor with no href, so it is not a functional link despite being presented as a link.
